title: hieracium tephrophilum
intro: Hieracium tephrophilum, commonly known as mountain hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion-like Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium tephrophilum are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which may contribute to its antimicrobial and antitumor activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Hieracium tephrophilum on human health.
